listings.thesis: Foundry and advanced-packaging option value, but external foundry revenue is still small and the segment is loss-making; alpha is turnaround rather than clean AI bottleneck exposure.

priorCase.rankRationale: AI-node lens: the Apple foundry report is a second prospective external anchor on 18A after the Google-TPU/Nvidia-EMIB validation, further answering this page's knock that external-foundry revenue is small. But it is unconfirmed, dated 2028+, on still-negative foundry margins, and a ~25% run since June 9 (52-week high) more than prices it. Small +1, hold rank.

listings.thesis: Silicon photonics and advanced packaging optionality, but stock is dominated by foundry/CPU turnaround.

priorCase.rankRationale: CPO lens: the Apple/foundry news validates the advanced-packaging/foundry leg but adds nothing on silicon-photonics/CPO, which is the half this page screens for. Stock still trades entirely on the foundry/CPU turnaround as the thesis warns, and it is now the most crowded semis name after a 52-week-high run. Hold.
